comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
The Sagres Adv. exp farming trick is:

1. Pick up 2 adventure finals (Geography+Archaeology) and complete them
2. Pick up merchant quest (honey is preferred due to ease) and complete it
3. You've "reset" your ability to accept quests (you cannot do the same quest twice in a row hence need to do delivery merch quest) and can re-take the 2 final quests again.

It may take some work, but there is no level at which these stop appearing.

Source: those who farmed to adventure 90 without issue using the above steps.
